subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and allow managed web_search to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, docs, tests, and the shipped release require explicit selection for key-free managed web_search providers, while this issue asks for the opposite default and affects outbound provider routing.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep DuckDuckGo selected only through tools.web.search.provider or the configure flow, and narrow the remaining work to diagnostics or setup guidance.

options.title: Approve implicit keyless fallback
options.body: Allow implicit keyless fallback only if the linked PR also aligns runtime metadata, setup defaults, docs, compatibility tests, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause the candidate PR
options.body: Leave the implementation unmerged until a provider-policy owner decides whether the behavior should exist at all.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep DuckDuckGo selected only through tools.web.search.provider or the configure flow, and narrow the remaining work to diagnostics or setup guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged explicit opt-in policy that the requested behavior would reverse.
